This lesson covers Miracles of Prophets • Nuh (A.S) • Musa (A.S) • Issa (A.S.), part of Pillars of Iman 3. in Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What is a miracle? 2. Why did prophets perform miracles?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. match/listen to stories of the miracles of the selected prophets from digital devices and make notes.
2. deduce lessons from the miracles of the selected prophets and present in class,
3. match the name of the prophets with miracles performed using flash cards,
4. draw, colour and display items related to the miracles of the selected prophet. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Miracles of Prophets • Nuh (A.S) • Musa (A.S) • Issa (A.S.) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

• Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of creativity as learners match the name of the prophets with miracles

performed using flash cards.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of experimenting as learners draw, colour and display items related to the miracles of

the selected prophet.

Values:
Respect as learners work together and share materials during class activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem through narration of the miracles performed by the prophets.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Creative Arts as they draw and colour different items.
